Good to know

Questions

 

Do I need an appointment?

Not for most cuts — walk-ins are welcome. For colour, perms and bridal parties, we recommend calling ahead at (905) 320-2288 so we can set aside enough time.

Where exactly are you in the mall?

Inside Westcliffe Mall at 620 Mohawk Rd W, Hamilton. Enter through any mall entrance and look for the yellow Super Clips storefront.

Do you cut kids' hair?

Yes — kids, parents and grandparents. Family visits are kind of our thing.

How much does a haircut cost?

Prices vary by service and hair length. Call us at (905) 320-2288 and we'll give you an exact quote before you come in — no surprises.

Ready when you are.

Walk in any time Monday to Saturday, or call ahead and we'll have a chair waiting.
